excerpts.content:
For the `engine_api`, the  `V2` methods are backwards compatible and can be called before the `Capella` fork.

However for the `4844` fork, the proposal for `ExecutionPayloadV3` is **not** backwards compatible because ~~`baseFeePerGas`~~ `excessDataGas` is not optional.. this implies we must switch methods AT the fork..
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/experimental/blob-extension.md#executionpayloadv3
